text:
sana: Alerting: spike in mTLS verify failures and OCSP timeouts in eu-west-2 starting 02:11 UTC. Looks different from the usual decrypt denies — proxies are failing verification because they can't fetch the latest public certs/ocsp responses.

sana: sample proxy log: 

sana: ```edge-proxy-09.log: 2026-05-04T02:12:03Z ERROR tls verify failed: ocsp: no stapled response; x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (CN=svc-ingress-proxy)```

kevin: interesting. which keystore API call is failing? getPublicKey vs decrypt? paste IAM/KMS audit snippets.

sana: audit excerpt: 

sana: ```iam.audit: 2026-05-04T02:10:58Z DENY method=keystore.GetPublicKey principal=serviceAccount:svc-cert-fetcher@prod reason=iamCondition=false resource=projects/keystore/cryptoKeys/edge-key/versions/5```

mike: We recently pushed a policy that tightened keystore.GetPublicKey to only allow callers with claim.aud=="cert-fetcher". If proxies are using a short-lived impersonation token with aud=proxy, they'll be denied read of public material. That prevents them from validating chains and retrieving OCSP data for stapling.

anya: Impact: handshake verify failures increase ~15% for eu-west-2 services, downstream clients drop connections, brief elevated latency and some 5xxs for model-serving endpoints. Not full outage but customer-visible.

kevin: remediation plan: 1) revert the conditional restriction on GetPublicKey (fast), 2) trigger a targeted cert-public re-fetch job to repopulate caches, 3) add audit logging to include impersonation_chain in iam logs so we can see delegated_by. I'll do 1 now.

ops-bot: IAM revert requested by kevin at 02:16 UTC. change-id=iam-revert-360123.

audit-bot: KMS/IAM Deny spike detected: resource=projects/keystore count=104 in 8m (threshold=12).

certbot: queued job: public-recache-euw2 job-id=pubrec-20260504-0218. Will attempt fetch and prime proxy caches.

sana: exact binding that landed earlier today: 

sana: ```yaml
- role: roles/keystore.getPublic
  members:
    - serviceAccount:svc-cert-fetcher@prod
  condition:
    title: require-fetcher-aud
    expression: "request.auth.claims.aud == 'cert-fetcher'"```

mike: that condition is too strict for proxy flows that legitimately impersonate for short hops. Reverted at 02:18 UTC.

kevin: After revert, public re-fetch job started at 02:19; cert caches primed by 02:23. Handshake failure rate fell back to baseline by 02:25.

anya: Two related config issues we noticed while triaging: some older proxies still have TLS profile set to allow these legacy RSA-only cipher suites and a minVersion of TLS1.2, while our verifier expects TLS1.3 and ECDHE curves; that mismatch makes OCSP stapling and chain validation stricter in practice. We'll sweep configs.

mike: Follow-ups (short):
- Add CI matrix for conditioned IAM bindings that tests GetPublicKey + impersonation chains + OCSP stapling.
- Ensure IAM/KMS audit payload surfaces the effective principal and full impersonation chain (serviceAccount, delegated_by).
- Run a proxy config sweep to set minVersion TLS1.3 and disable RSA-only ciphers in eu-west-2.
- Add a short-term runbook step: if KMS GetPublicKey denies spike correlates with OCSP/tls verify spike, consider immediate IAM revert and run public-recache job.

kevin: I'll own the CI test and the audit payload change. mike can you coordinate the proxy TLS sweep?

mike: Yep, scheduling config job and a canary. Also adding a small telemetry query to alert when (KMS Deny > 20/min for GetPublicKey) && (tls_verify_fail_rate > 5%) by region.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20260504-keystore-public-read created by kevin. Severity: P2. Linked ticket: https://internal.redwood/tickets/SEC-2026-075

audit-bot: Note: current iam audit entries do not reliably include the impersonation chain. Filed follow-up to capture delegated_principal in logs.

sana: Security note: conditioned bindings are great for least-priv, but public metadata reads (GetPublicKey/GetCert) are often part of cross-service verification flows and need allowances for impersonation or a documented delegation path. Add to our policy doc.

certbot: public-recache job pubrec-20260504-0218 completed: primed 12/12 proxies in eu-west-2. status=success.

anya: Handshake errors normalized. Postmortem will include timeline + config snapshot + CI test PR. I'll open PM doc now and link.

kevin: Good catch, sana. Closing thread when PM link is attached. PM: https://internal.redwood/pm/INC-20260504-keystore-public-read
